topIssues.title: S2 docs: Card anatomy examples close <CardPreview> with </CardView>
topIssues.bodyExcerpt:
In `packages/dev/s2-docs/pages/s2/Card.mdx` on main (e36b8c2), the anatomy examples for `AssetCard`, `UserCard` and `ProductCard` open `<CardPreview>` and close it with `</CardView>`:

- AssetCard: lines 289-291
- UserCard: lines 306-308
- ProductCard: lines 325-327

Copying them gives invalid JSX.
